---
title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
attacks <- read_csv("data/attacks_clean.csv") |> 
  mutate(
    Country_lower = str_to_lower(str_trim(Country)),
    Fatal_clean = case_when(
      Fatal == "Y" ~ "Fatal",
      Fatal == "N" ~ "Non-fatal",
      .default = "Unknown"
    )
  )

write_rds(attacks, "data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
world_map <- map_data("world") |> 
  mutate(Country_lower = str_to_lower(region))

attack_counts <- attacks |> 
  count(Country_lower, name = "attacks")

world_attacks <- world_map |> 
  left_join(attack_counts, by = "Country_lower")

ggplot(world_attacks, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = attacks)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Blues", direction = 1, trans = "log1p", na.value = "#edf2f7") +
  theme_void() +
  labs(
    title = "Shark Attacks by Country",
    fill = "Attacks"
  )
```
